conf.description: zos-racf resource-access, format other: hand-built IRRADU00 ACCESS-extension KVP-delimited parse (SMF80 event 02), event.outcome derived from ACC_VIOLATION plus ACC_USER_WARNING, file.path conditional on ACC_CLASS=DATASET with an unconditional racf.resource.name copy, no LPAR UTC offset available.

conf.comment: zos-racf/resource-access/other (IRRADU00 ACCESS extension unload). Site formatter output assumed KVP (literal ACC_-prefixed keys) per this project's zos-smf/tcpip and dataset-access precedent -- true byte-offset column grammar is unpublished here and not confirmed against a sample. event.outcome derives from ACC_VIOLATION plus ACC_USER_WARNING per the work order's own instruction ('must be consulted before treated as a clean success'): warning-mode NO is treated as failure, not success, since ECS has no third warning outcome; raw ACC_USER_WARNING is kept on racf.access.warning_mode for transparency. file.path populated only when ACC_CLASS is DATASET, racf.resource.name always. No LPAR UTC offset is supplied anywhere in this work order so _time has no zone correction (gap, see README). ACC_LOGSTR capping and the SUCCESS-volume suppression list are both recommended but unspecified (no length/list given) -- neither invented, both flagged as gaps in README.
